title: Severin
creator: CrossFit
description: 50 strict pull-ups, 100 hand-release push-ups and a 5 km run, in a vest, for time. Honours U.S. Army Special Forces Sgt. 1st Class Severin W. Summers III, killed by an IED in Qole Gerdsar, Afghanistan, in 2009. Do the pull-ups strict even if it means small sets.
